event.description: Remove only the final LayerNorm bias
event.proposal: family: normalization; current retained incumbent is 3136 parameters at 99.9500%, a +0.95 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0028, affine-free attention and FF pre-norms at 3456/99.92%; same-family failed result: attempt-0029, removing both final scale and bias in that context at 3424/95.58%; prior attempts in this family: 5. Hypothesis: the failed all-affine removal may have lost useful output scaling, while the final shift alone may be redundant after the two block pre-norms are affine-free. Remove only the 16-parameter final bias and retain the learned final scale, yielding 3120 parameters. This is more informative than repeating full final-affine removal because it isolates scale from shift and is the nearest untested normalization ablation; the nearest alternative is removing only the scale, which changes output calibration more directly. Keep the successful per-head attention organization, ff16, all other norms, learned positions, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3136 parameters.
